_readme: Master timeline. Seconds, not frames. Read by src/lib/timeline.ts (the film) and render/temp-score.py (temp music). Scenes marked perVilla repeat once per villa type in src/config/project.ts; later types use only shots marked inCondensed. On-screen wording lives in src/config/project.ts (Arabic only); text cues here only say where and when.

scenes.title: From Earth to Yanbu
scenes.music: Atmospheric: a single low string note under a soft high shimmer; the build begins as the clouds part.

shots.visual: Earth from orbit at dawn. The terminator line crosses the Arabian Peninsula; the Red Sea catches first light. Very slow drift forward.
Continuous push down toward the Red Sea coast of Saudi Arabia. High cirrus streaks past the lens.
The camera breaks through the cloud layer: the Yanbu coastline and the Royal Commission city grid resolve below. Heading for the project site.

scenes.title: The JABEEN Project Reveal
scenes.music: Reveal: timpani and full strings land as the site fills the frame, then settle into a sustained chord under the title.

shots.visual: Aerial reveal and slow orbit of the actual site. The master-plan line-work traces onto the terrain, then resolves into the 3D neighbourhood model (camera-matched to the aerial plate).

scenes.title: Exploring the Neighbourhood
scenes.music: Momentum: strings in motion, light percussion pulse.

shots.visual: Descend from the reveal height toward the neighbourhood rooftops.
Low glide along a residential street from the master plan, villas passing on both sides.
Slow orbit around a cluster of villas, showing the supplied landscaping and outdoor spaces.

scenes.title: Approaching the Villa
scenes.music: Transition: the pulse drops away, leaving warm low strings.

shots.visual: Wide exterior of the selected villa type in its plot.
Slow dolly toward the facade: materials, openings, entrance and outdoor space.
Push through the entrance; the doorway frame becomes the wipe into the interior.

scenes.title: The Interior Experience
scenes.music: Flowing: a sophisticated string theme with piano, unhurried.

shots.visual: Living area: slow lateral glide revealing the space and the light.
Kitchen: gentle push along the counters.
Stair or hallway moving the camera between zones (only if the supplied design has one).
Master bedroom: slow arc toward the window.
Second bedroom.
Bathroom detail: materials and fittings.

scenes.title: The Architectural Floor-Plan Reveal
scenes.music: Softer: strings thin to a high sustained line and piano; space for the annotations.

shots.visual: Crane straight up through the ceiling and roof; the roof dissolves into a cutaway as the camera settles directly overhead.
Overhead cutaway render, camera-matched to the plan, crossfades into the actual 2D floor plan. Lines draw on; room names, dimensions and the specification panel appear in sequence.

scenes.title: Neighbourhood and Landscaping
scenes.music: Rebuild: the theme returns, fuller, rising toward the finale.

shots.visual: Pull up and out from the villa plan into the site/landscape plan, which dissolves into the realistic 3D environment.
Ground-level glide through the supplied landscaping and outdoor areas.
Low aerial across the streets and landscape, villa in context.

scenes.title: Inspirational Closing
scenes.music: Finale: full orchestra, uplifting; resolves on a long final chord over the end frame.

shots.visual: Sweeping golden-hour aerial rising over the whole neighbourhood.
End frame: company and JABEEN logos on a warm ivory field, original colours preserved.
